changes.title: Canopy hider
items: Coming down from the treetops, the canopy now opens round you smoothly as the camera comes down, and closes as you rise, instead of switching all at once

changes.title: Elder fox ram
items: The fox's legend is now an old shrine fox: nine silver-tipped tails, a grizzled muzzle and a bitten ear, a red rope and bell at its throat, rings in its ears
The ram's legend is now the old bellwether: weathered horns ringed in bronze with one tip broken, a bell at its throat and a garland of heather

changes.title: Jaguar
items: A new creature for the jungle west: the black jaguar, stocky and big-headed, black with rosettes a shade darker that show only in the light

Its legend is the elder of the jaguars: a huge head and crushing jaw, a grey muzzle, old scars, its hidden rosettes surfacing in the moonlight and rippling as it moves, a collar of jade and bronze beads
Its own area, the River jungle: a dark river under rainforest giants hung with lianas, vinewood glowing in the gloom, and a heap of mossed, fallen giants by the water
The jaguar's legend gives Jaguar's Night eyes: 💌s fly further and a little faster
